mutations.name: G1 the role/capability guard is dropped: a wire-defined persona spawned with role manager is accepted again and joins as a manager that silently cannot spawn (issue #966 verbatim)
mutations.expectRed: the spawn is refused (the tool result is an error)

mutations.name: G2 the guard stops keying on the EFFECTIVE role and reads the file's instead: the spawn-time role override — the exact call in the issue, cotal_spawn(name, role: "manager") — slips past it and the seat joins mislabelled again
mutations.expectRed: the spawn is refused (the tool result is an error)

mutations.name: G3 the refusal loses its remediation: an operator peer reading the error is told the spawn failed but not that capabilities: [spawn] on the persona file is the fix
mutations.find: `An operator adds \`capabilities: [spawn]\` to ${configPath}; a peer-defined persona ` +
mutations.replace: `An operator can fix this; a peer-defined persona ` +
mutations.expectRed: the refusal tells an operator the file remedy (capabilities: [spawn])

mutations.name: G4 the refusal loses the peer half of the remediation: a peer that defined the persona over the wire is left with no route to the grant, which is the silence this change exists to remove
mutations.find: `(cotal_persona) cannot declare capabilities by design — ask an operator to grant it.`,
mutations.expectRed: the refusal tells a peer author to ask an operator (it cannot self-serve the grant)
